updates.rationale: This active sibling program organizes a distinct scalar-converse route. Its research effort is assigned to its threads, while the route itself remains part of the no-access portfolio.
This node functions as an active agenda marker rather than a separate technical work package; substantive discovery and fallback work are accounted on the program's technical threads.

Without access to the withheld contribution, researchers must independently formulate and prove the product-factorization and receiver-skew reductions, establish their scope, connect them to the canonical BSSC scalar bound, and audit hostile correlated-input cases. The multiple proof, computation, and certification components make this a sustained primary thread.

A fallback search is conditionally pursued when the structured product-and-symmetry route stalls or exposes unresolved cases. Its scale follows the comparable unstructured converse-search package in the accounting base state.
